gre_subject.value: Neither the General nor the Chemistry Subject GRE is required; there is no need to send scores.
gre_subject.quote: The general and subject GRE exams are NOT required. There is no need to submit these scores.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not required.
gre_general.quote: The general and subject GRE exams are NOT required. There is no need to submit these scores.

supervisor.value: You are admitted to the department, not a lab; you join a group in your first fall after three rotations.
supervisor.quote: it is not necessary to contact a professor as students are admitted into the chemistry department and not into a professor’s research group. You join a research group in the fall semester of your first year after 3 rotations and a group-joining process.

funding.value: With few exceptions, admitted PhD students get five years of support at 50% time or more (TA, RA, traineeship or fellowship), subject to progress and funds.
funding.quote: With few exceptions, students admitted to the PhD program in the Department of Chemistry are offered support for five continuous academic years contingent on satisfactory academic progress and availability of funds.

entry_route.value: Apply from a bachelor's covering standard chemistry, a year of physics and calculus; the department is mainly PhD-granting.
entry_route.quote: Prospective graduate students are expected to have satisfactorily completed the equivalent in classes and labs of the fundamental courses in chemistry offered at UW–Madison, one year of physics, and mathematics through calculus.

also.quote: The UW-Madison graduate program is primarily a Ph.D.-granting program.

fee_waiver.value: Graduate School fee grants require US citizenship or permanent residency; the department does not mention its own waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: To receive a fee grant from the Graduate School, a prospective applicant must be a US citizen or permanent resident to be eligible.

english_waiver.value: A TOEFL waiver depends on English being the exclusive language of instruction at your college or university, not on your country.
english_waiver.quote: A TOEFL waiver may be granted based upon the language of instruction at the college or university level and how recently you completed your education at the institution rather than the country of origin/citizenship or current residence.

notes: International TAs must take the SPEAK test if their prior degree was not taught in English. Fall 2026: 1200 applications, 34 enrolled.
